problem: Readiness reports writes allowed despite an active transaction or recovery block; global permission claim ignores tool-specific checks.
acceptance: Report idle, active transaction and recovery state accurately.
Never promise an individual edit is authorized.
No asset mutation, compile or save.
Live help names actual behavior and toolset.
limitations: PIE, simulation, non-editor and unavailable transaction-system branches are source-reviewed only.
Readiness is a point-in-time diagnostic, not a reservation or authorization for a particular tool.
Asset/source-control/per-tool preference checks remain with each edit.

checks: Idle readiness is not blanket permission
Recovery gate blocks readiness and explains next step
evidence.effects: No assets edited, compiled or saved by this fixture; temporary test transaction is cancelled and fixture recovery latch reset.
